top_signals.title: Dangote Aims to Raise $1.6 Bln in Nigeria's Biggest IPO
top_signals.summary: Billionaire Aliko Dangote is seeking to raise $1.6 billion in what would be Nigeria’s biggest initial public offering. Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals FZE is offering 4.1 billion shares at 525 naira ($0.40) each, a company spokesman said Friday. The IPO will open on Sept. 14. Bloomberg's Anthony Osae-Brown reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Israel-Hezbollah clashes deepen threat to fragile truce as Lebanon's president calls for U.S. support
top_signals.summary: Lebanese President Joseph Aoun called on the U.S. to help stop Israeli attacks after Sunday strikes killed at least seven people.
